beats: At dusk Polyphemus returns carrying a massive load of wood and drives his flock inside.
He lifts a stone slab that no ordinary team could move and blocks the entrance.
He milks ewes and goats, sets young beneath mothers, curdles milk, and lights a fire.
The fire reveals the hidden men and the giant demands their identity.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Book nine. The Cyclops's cave. Escape beneath the rams. Take one.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Why is the camera in the ram?

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: The ram was the hottest thing in the scene. I go where the heat is.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means: get out of the sheep.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: New rule. No lens inside an animal.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Odysseus, six men, three rams, a ship and a giant.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: I'll take your word for it.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: New rule. A frame that is nearly black is refused.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He wants to be shot from below.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: From above, the eye was never where his head was.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Half your face is in shadow.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: The stone. He seals the cave. Take one.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: It was beside the door. Now it is in the door.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Take two. This time he carries it.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: The milking. We lit it again.
